header: make up every element, and a test fails if one is missing
lead: Value and unit are plain text, so € 1,200,000 and 1.2 m both appear exactly as typed. The heading is the sentence the figure completes, not a section title.
note: Settings, two templates, a stylesheet, an icon, labels in two languages and three sets of demo content. Counted in Astryx for TYPO3 2.4.
